svg.desc: Banner in the SynthSkills studio-lab brand. Headline: Give your agents the playbooks of a working studio. 288 skills in 20 areas, one MCP address, https://skills.synthlabs.pk/mcp. Skill cards for headless-blender-batch-render, audio-mixing-mastering and film-dubbing-pipeline; sections read 2 of 14.
